name: Feed Health Monitor for WooCommerce
author: nersesgh

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/feed-health-monitor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Feed Health
sections.faq:
Does this plugin generate a feed?

No, this plugin only monitors your catalog for data issues.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: Advanced price validation (invalid formats, zero/negative amounts, faulty sale prices).
  • New: Title quality checks (character limits, promotional text detection).
  • New: Description quality checks (flagging thin descriptions).
  • New: Advanced image checks (invalid URLs, width/height checks against minimum/recommended sizes).
  • New: Strict GTIN format and checksum validation.
  • Tweak: Deeply enhanced variable product parsing that avoids issue spam.

1.1.0

  • New: Background scheduled scans via WP Cron (Daily/Weekly).
  • New: Scan history view to compare historical trends.
  • New: Detect newly introduced issues and recently fixed issues.
  • New: Optional email alerts for critical issues and health score drops.
  • Tweak: Added data retention cleanup tasks.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
sections.description:
Find WooCommerce product data issues that can cause Google Shopping and product feed errors before they hurt your product listings.

Find Product Feed Issues Before They Become Problems

Feed Health Monitor for WooCommerce scans your WooCommerce catalog for product data issues that can cause products to be rejected, limited, or excluded from product feeds.

It helps you identify missing, incomplete, or potentially problematic product information before it affects your product listings on platforms such as Google Shopping.

What does it check?

The plugin analyzes your WooCommerce products for common feed-related data problems, including:

  • Missing product titles
  • Missing product descriptions
  • Missing product images
  • Missing prices
  • Missing stock information
  • Missing product identifiers
  • Missing or incomplete attributes
  • Product data that may cause feed validation problems
  • Other catalog issues that can affect product feeds

Advanced Data Quality Validation (New in 1.2.0)

Version 1.2.0 introduces deep qualitative checks across your catalog to catch problematic content:
* Price Validation: Flags invalid, zero, or negative prices, and alerts when sale prices exceed regular prices.
* Title Quality: Identifies suspiciously short or long titles and flags promotional text (e.g. “FREE SHIPPING”, “SALE”).
* Description Quality: Flags extremely thin product descriptions.
* Image Validation: Checks for valid image URLs and enforces minimum/recommended image dimensions (e.g. 250×250 minimum, 800×800 recommended).
* GTIN Validation: Enforces strict GTIN formatting, lengths, and Modulus-10 checksum validation.
* Variable Products: Inspects all active variations securely, rolling up grouped errors efficiently without spamming issues.

Why use Feed Health Monitor?

Instead of discovering product problems after your products have been rejected by a shopping platform, scan your catalog directly from WordPress and identify issues that need attention.

Built for WooCommerce

Feed Health Monitor works directly with your WooCommerce product catalog and provides a simple way to review product data health from your WordPress dashboard.

Google Shopping & Product Feeds

Product feed platforms depend on accurate and complete product information. Small catalog issues can result in products being rejected or excluded.

Feed Health Monitor helps you find potential problems before they become feed issues.

No Feed Generation Required

This plugin does not generate product feeds.

It focuses specifically on checking the health of your WooCommerce product data so you can identify problems before sending your catalog to external feed platforms.

Who is it for?

Feed Health Monitor is useful for:

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Ecommerce managers
  • SEO specialists
  • Google Shopping advertisers
  • Agencies managing WooCommerce stores
  • Developers maintaining product catalogs

Continuous Monitoring & Alerts

With version 1.1.0, Feed Health Monitor now acts as an active watchdog:
* Schedule automated background scans (Daily or Weekly).
* Compare current catalog health against historical scan data.
* View scan history with new vs. fixed issues metrics.
* Get email notifications when critical issues appear or the health score drops.

Free and Lightweight

The plugin focuses on catalog health monitoring without adding unnecessary complexity to your WooCommerce store.

Install Feed Health Monitor and find product data issues before they become feed problems.
